title: Inspecting notebook environment setup
description: You can distinguish a defined command helper from the statements actually executed.

steps.description: _sh defines a helper that captures command output and prints a failure message if an exception occurs. You define it here without calling it.
The active statements print a Python version, platform string and a module-membership check. The check asks whether google.colab is already in sys.modules.

steps.question: Do the two installation lines execute in this snippet?
steps.answer: No. Both lines are comments, and the helper is never called.

steps.description: The recording reports Python 3.12.16, a Linux platform and In Colab: False. You see environment information rather than installation output.
